episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick shares her strategies for managing client hesitation in volatile markets and the importance of direct communication. She emphasizes the value of answering calls and maintaining backup plans with multiple buyers. Her empathetic and strategic approach to client management provides actionable insights for agents looking to excel in high-stakes real estate transactions.
